chunks: And by this chain, from Aban, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that the two of them said:

When the people belied the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), Allah, Blessed and Exalted, intended the destruction of the people of the earth, except for Ali and no one else, by His Statement: 'Then turn your back upon them, for you are not to blame.'
Then He changed it for them, so He was Merciful to the Believers.
Then He said to His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): 'And remind, for indeed the reminder benefits the believers.'

key_terms.فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ: then turn your back upon them

ai.seo_question: What did Allah intend to do with the people of the earth when they rejected the Prophet, and how did He show mercy?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the unique status of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) as the sole exception from destruction when Allah initially intended to annihilate humanity due to their rejection of the Prophet. It illustrates the divine transition from wrath to mercy, culminating in the command for the Prophet to continue his mission of reminder, which serves as a source of benefit specifically for the believers.
